comments.LineComment: | Exhaustive property-based tests for Diffusion primitives.
| Generators are weighted toward realistic production values, not random noise.
| This catches bugs that occur in actual usage, not just edge cases.

value.value: default config has positive batch size
height and width must be positive
generated percent pairs maintain ordering when properly constructed
sigmaMin must be less than sigmaMax
All presets must have valid CFG
